title: Rotating Shafts - Torque
description: Calculate torsional moments or torque acting on rotating shafts. Torque is expressed as T = 63057 × Php / n, where Php is horsepower (hp) and n is revolution per minute (rpm). Results can be expressed in lb-in or Nm.

components.content:
## Formula

T = 63057 × Php / n

Where:
- **T** = Torque or moment (lb-in)
- **Php** = Horsepower (hp)
- **n** = Revolution per minute (rpm)

## Conversion Factors

- 1 hp (English horsepower) = 745.7 W
- 1 lb-in = 0.113 Nm
